build_vit_encoder: build a Vision Transformer encoder module from a pretrained checkpoint with custom resolution and frame handling
load_pretrained_vit_model: load a pretrained Vision Transformer model from a checkpoint file with state dict key filtering
register_forward_prehook: register a forward prehook that expands 2D image input to 3D video tensor for frame repetition
init_vjepa2_encoder: initialize a V-JEPA2-compatible encoder module with embed_dim attribute and forward protocol
configure_model_kwargs: configure encoder model kwargs including model name, checkpoint key, and resolution for Vit initialization
